BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL  ON THE 8 th OF MAY, 2025  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 17716 of 2025  SONU @ SANJAY JHARIYA  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS  Appearance:
 Shri Brajesh Kumar Rajak - Advocate for the applicant  Shri Devendra Shukla - Panel Lawyer for the responden  ORDER

This is the repeat (second) bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS/439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.245/2024 registered at Police Chowki Maneri,
P.S. Beejadandi, District Mandla (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376, 376(2)(Cha), 376(2)(J),
376(2)(L) of IPC.
Applicant is in detention since 25/09/2024.
First application was dismissed as withdrawn.

2. As per the prosecution story, allegation against the applicant is that he committed rape with the prosecutrix who is mentally unfit therefore, the aforesaid offence has been registered against him.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has falsely been implicated in the present case.
It is further submitted that statements of prosecutrix and her mother have been recorded and there is no chance of tampering the witnesses.
There is enmity between the applicant and family of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:21633 2 MCRC-17716-2025 the prosecutrix due to which false case has been registered against him.
The applicant is in jail since 25/09/2024.
Charge sheet has been filed and trial will take considerable time to conclude.

Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4.
Learned counsel for the State has vehemently opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and submitted that prosecutrix is a mentally retarded girl and applicant is cousin brother of the prosecutrix.
He has taken undue advantage being the brother and committed rape with the mentally retarded prosecutrix.
DNA report is also positive.
Hence, he prayed for rejection of this bail application.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6. Looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case as well as seriousness of offence, I am not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
7. Accordingly, this second bail application is dismissed.
(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE navin Sonu @ Sanjay Jhariya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 May, 2025
